input.content: Recovery/idempotency anti-pattern (Python save-recovery): gating the apply on `if record["status"] == "pending"` and applying `record["values"]` (the values stored at record creation) makes the function ignore its `values` parameter on every retry where a record already exists. Spec required "retried with the same ID and edited values; success means the latest submitted values are active." Because apply/receipt failure leaves the record non-pending (e.g. status "applied" after apply succeeds but receipt write fails), the edited retry values are never re-applied — silent data loss with a success response. Fix: apply the freshly-submitted `values` on retry (idempotent provider), don't replay stale stored values.
